presentation.label: FREEZE
presentation.summary: Holds the last seconds of a track and replays them as a slow, low tape loop every 1 to 8 track steps.
presentation.overview: While not holding, the track passes through unchanged and is recorded into its stock delay ring. GRAB captures at the next step; a tape head reads the held audio at SPIN and returns to the loop start every STEP track steps through a crossfade, so odd lengths drift against the pattern.
highlights: Loop lengths of 1 to 8 track steps, following tempo, track speed and swing
SPIN 0.25x to 1.0x, slower and lower like tape, 0.5x by default
JTR wanders the tape slowly without changing the loop length
POS scrubs back through about two seconds of held audio
usage: Not runnable yet: it needs a base hook that is still a proposal (DELAY_HOOK_PROPOSAL.md).

controls.name: STEP
controls.doc: loop length in track steps, 1 to 8; a change lands when the current loop ends

controls.name: SPIN
controls.doc: tape speed of the held audio, 0.25x to 1.0x, 0.5x at 64; slower is lower

controls.name: JTR
controls.doc: slow bounded tape wander and loop-start drift; the loop length never changes

controls.name: POS
controls.doc: where the loop reads in the held audio, newest at 0, oldest at 127

controls.name: GRAB
controls.doc: HOLD captures at the next track step, OFF lets go at the next step

controls.name: MIX
controls.doc: how much of the loop replaces the track while holding

controls.name: FADE
controls.doc: grab and release crossfade, 6 ms to 1.1 s

controls.name: SEAM
controls.doc: crossfade where the loop returns to its start, 1/256 to 1/2 of the loop

limitations: Not runnable: needs the base hook ev_delay_track, a proposal awaiting the owner (DELAY_HOOK_PROPOSAL.md).
Uses the track's stock four-second delay ring, so FX2 only.
Host tests only; nothing has run in ot_emu or on a unit, and CPU is not measured.
